items: + Low-end PC mode (Settings → Video → Performance mode, Auto by default): on PCs with few CPU threads, little RAM, no GPU video encoder or CPU recording, detection captures 10 instead of 20 fps and full-screen text recognition is off (kill feed and kill notifications stay on)
+ Detection rests while nothing can happen: when FiveM isn't the active window or during black/loading screens, its capture slows to 2 fps and wakes up as soon as FiveM is back
+ Warning in the Detection Log when recording falls back to the CPU, with what to do about it
/ Detection now copies only the centre area it analyses from the graphics card (native pixels) plus a small 1280×720 frame 4× per second, about 70 % less data than before
/ The recorder runs at normal instead of above-normal priority, and the detection capture below normal, so the game always comes first

t: Small kill-X markers and kill notifications
items: + Magnified centre scan: a second, zoomed-in analysis of the crosshair area finds small, server-specific kill-X markers (about 3× smaller than GTA's), also next to a blood splash
+ Tolerant red: darker, washed-out kill-X reds (graphics mods, bloom, thin lines) are recognised; brick walls, skin, red cars, neon stripes, circles and plus signs still don't trigger

+ Kill notifications: a new green notification on the left is spotted within 0.2 s and read at once from an enlarged crop; "Du hast [Name | ID] getötet" / "You killed …" is strong kill evidence on its own
+ Death notifications: a new red "Du wurdest von [Name | ID] getötet" / "You were killed by …" message holds auto clips for 4 s
/ Kill messages are recognised even when they wrap onto two lines or OCR misreads letters (e.g. "Du host … getdtet")
/ Kill messages count as strong evidence for the gunfire check (like your name in the kill feed)
/ The background detection feed captures at up to 1600 px for the sharper magnified scan; the post-check uses both scans

t: Kill detection with graphics mods (NVE, ReShade, colour filters)
items: + Kill-X colour learning: make one kill and press your clip hotkey, and FRAG//V finds the kill-X in that clip and learns its colour; it then looks for that colour as well as standard red
+ Kills confirmed by the kill feed without a visible kill-X also teach the colour automatically
+ Red-heavy scenes: red signs, red lighting and colour grading behind the crosshair are filtered out, so a kill-X on top of them is still found
+ Settings → Kill Detection: "Kill-X colour (graphics mods)" with the learned colour, a Reset button and an on/off toggle
/ The post-check of saved clips uses the same colour handling as live detection
/ Training samples record the learned kill-X colour

t: Performance: lighter detection, no FPS drop when saving
items: + Fast save: clips from the native recorder are saved without re-encoding the video (stream copy), so saving no longer costs GPU/CPU while you play; the clip may start up to 2 s earlier
+ Settings → Video: "Fast save" toggle (on by default; off = exact frame-accurate cut, re-encoded)
/ Clip saving, Discord copies and post-checks run at below-normal priority with limited threads, so the game keeps its CPU time
/ Text recognition (the heaviest detector) only runs around action: gunfire, a kill-X candidate or new kill-feed rows, plus a slow check every 8 s
/ Kill-X detector skips frames without red near the crosshair after a quick check of the centre instead of analysing the whole crop
/ Background detection feed runs at 20 fps instead of 30
/ The window's own screen capture drops to 2 fps while FRAG//V is hidden or not on Watched Monitor (native recorder)
/ Waiting for FiveM / Discord audio checks the process list every 5 s instead of every 1.4 s; audio meters only update on the Audio Tracks page

t: Auto detection works minimized and in the background
items: + Background-safe detection feed: detection now gets its own DXGI capture of your monitor (bundled FFmpeg), independent of the FRAG//V window
+ Settings → Kill Detection: "Background-safe detection" toggle (on by default)
+ Watched Monitor and Dashboard show which detection input is used and its frame rate
+ Detection Log warns when auto detection stops receiving frames
/ Auto detection keeps working while FRAG//V is minimized, in the tray or behind FiveM (single-monitor setups)
/ Clip thumbnails and training snapshots also come from the background feed, so they no longer freeze while the window is hidden
/ The feed restarts by itself after display mode changes or fullscreen switches
+ Gunfire detection: FRAG//V listens to the FiveM audio for shots; kill evidence with no gunfire nearby is held (your name in the kill feed still counts for melee and vehicle kills)
+ "Maybe" clips: likely but uncertain kills are saved with a MAYBE tag; keep or discard them in My Clips, the rest are deleted automatically after 6 h, 24 h or 3 days
+ Post-check: every saved auto clip is analysed again around the kill and marked VERIFIED or UNSURE; verified "maybe" clips become normal clips
+ Detection Accuracy card on the Dashboard: precision, kills caught, post-check results and maybe-clip stats from your ✓/✗ feedback
+ Watched Monitor shows the gunfire gate status and when the last shot was heard
+ "Maybe" filter in My Clips
+ Settings: Require gunfire for auto clips, "Maybe" clips with auto-delete time
/ Labelling a "maybe" clip trains the detector the same way as ✓ / ✗ feedback

t: Smarter kill detection: gameplay gates, your name, feedback
items: + Detection only runs while FiveM / GTA V is the active window (setting, on by default)
+ Black and loading screens pause detection; pause menu, big map and cutscenes (HUD/minimap gone) pause text detection while the kill-X keeps watching
+ Watched Monitor chip and dashboard Status show whether detection is live or paused, and why
+ "Your player name" setting: a new kill-feed line starting with your name is strong kill evidence; your name as the victim holds auto clips for 4 s
+ ✓ Yes / ✗ No feedback on auto and manual clips (cards and player)
+ Training samples: every auto kill and manual clip saves the last 3 s of centre crops, a frame and the evidence scores, plus a settings toggle, stats and Open folder button
+ Developer tools: scripts/calibrate-clips.js replays clips through the kill-X detector; scripts/test-gate.js replays them through the gameplay gate
/ False multi-kill clips fixed at the root: full-screen OCR was reading kill words from other windows (e.g. a console) while FiveM wasn't in front
/ Kill fusion adds +18 when your name is in the feed alongside other evidence

+ Audio Tracks toggle "Mixed track first" (on by default)
